weapons.weapon_mahmut_signature: His Crown Guard sword. The night he hammered the crest from his armor, he filled the hilt's crest socket with plain iron. An oath with the name filed off still cuts.
weapons.weapon_fadyme_signature: The silver bell of House Veyr, carried on a chain. Its clapper is a silver thorn that has never needed to swing; when Fadyme casts, it rings anyway, and the other bells answer.
weapons.weapon_kera_voss_signature: The brass mortar of Kera's first master, expelled from the Red Vial Guild for refusing the ledger wing. Measured twice, poured once, regretted never.
weapons.weapon_brin_alder_signature: An axe-shield cut from the alder that shaded her village shrine. A tree does not stand for itself.
weapons.weapon_nixie_vale_signature: A shortbow whose grip is wrapped in the map that lied on the forest road. Trust the wind; check the map.
weapons.weapon_aveline_last_vigil: A reliquary staff crowned with a sun-disc, lit at every door Aveline will not leave until the last person is out. The candle is not for the saint. It is for whoever is still inside.
weapons.weapon_sable_broken_bell: Twin courier blades bound with the rope Sable cut from the signal bell on the Bridge of the Forsaken. Silence is a message too.
weapons.weapon_tilda_fen_signature: A reed staff hung with sea-glass vials from the salt road where Tilda learned to heal. Salt cleans. It also stings.
weapons.weapon_rikka_ember_signature: A festival spear with a bell tassel, first lit at Rikka's first kiln procession. Loud enough to be heard by the living.
weapons.weapon_mirel_unwritten_ledger: A brass astrolabe folio with a stylus dagger. Its last page is always blank. Some pages wait for the right hand.
weapons.weapon_odelia_pike_signature: A harbor longbow with net-knotted arrows. Watch the water, not the ripple.
weapons.weapon_pippa_bell_signature: A lute-sling with a trembling bell charm tied to its neck. A name sung is a name witnessed.
weapons.weapon_nara_gatewarden_promise: The glaive and compact kite shield of the Vell bridge wardens, passed from mother to daughter. The first thing the stone hits.
weapons.weapon_clem_marr_signature: A ritual lantern whose light shows chalk names beneath moss. Most names are only hiding.
weapons.weapon_vespera_last_hour: A glass lantern and focus ring from the sealed conservatory. Look long enough and it shows you what it cost.
weapons.weapon_hana_birch_signature: A hatchet and small snare from Hana's forest post. Stillness is also a strike.
weapons.weapon_thistle_roe_signature: A thorn crook cut from the Saint Luthos bell garden. Plant before the frost, not after.
weapons.weapon_iona_mist_signature: A tidal censer and river lantern. No one crosses the fog alone.
weapons.weapon_jori_flint_signature: A hammer-shield set with a rivet from the Flint family's chain die. Every door has a smith. Choose which side you stand on.
weapons.weapon_marek_vane_signature: A herald's spear-horn with its pennant removed after Crownfall. The road needs rhythm more than colors.

enemies.ash_wolf: Wolves that ate from bell-ash in the Whispering Forest. They hunt whoever walks apart from the pack.
enemies.bellbound_dead: Hollows wired to a bell by their own chains. Alone they are weak; the bell never sends one alone.
enemies.bridge_revenant: A drowned sentry of the old span. It still hooks anyone who stands at the front, as if the gate had never fallen.
enemies.chain_cultist: Chain-bearers of the First Eclipse. They pray to an eclipse that never moves and share one another's wounds.
enemies.choir_knight: Oath-armor of the Saint Luthos choir guard. It sings without breath and strikes back when a brother is struck.
enemies.corrupted_crown_guard: Crown Guard soldiers still following Crown-era orders. The shield comes up before the signal strike, as it was drilled.
enemies.corrupted_mercenary: Hired blades of the Red Vial ledger wing, fed on red glass that makes them strong and careless.
enemies.crownless_knight: A knight who stripped his own crest, not out of defiance but despair. It hates shields and ignores fear.
enemies.eclipse_sentinel: Warders of the First Eclipse who feed the altar's barrier through its pylons.
enemies.estate_wraith: A noble shade of the Ashen estate. Having lost its name, it borrows the strongest protection it can see.
enemies.glass_viper: A glass-scaled serpent bred in the Red Vial cisterns. Fast, fragile, and never sold to anyone who asked what it was for.
enemies.hollow_cleric: A grave scribe that still keeps its ledger. It mends its own and curses whoever looks weakest.
enemies.hollow_pilgrim: A pilgrim whose hours ran out on the road but whose feet did not. Slow, stubborn, heavy.
enemies.inkbound_dead: A corpse wrapped in erased records. The ink it bleeds marks the living for the dead.
enemies.lost_vow_knight: A dead knight of a broken order. It punishes every shield it sees, because its own failed.
enemies.noble_retainer: The ghost of a household attendant. It still steps in front of the most wounded master.
enemies.orchard_ghoul: The Oakhaven dead, bloated from the red harvest. The more it feeds, the harder it becomes to cut.
enemies.red_vial_alchemist: A ledger-wing bomber. Break the flask rack and the formula breaks with it.
enemies.red_vial_scout: A Guild courier with a poison dart and a route-marking shot. It reports to whoever pays in seals.
enemies.royal_hollow: A palace guard still standing at a post that no longer exists. It blocks one blow each round, as it always did.
enemies.boss_ash_maw: A wolf carcass fused with a shard of the Whispering Bell. Not a wolf: what the bell left wearing one.
enemies.boss_bell_widow: Lady Yseldra Vale, former Royal Inquisitor. She seals her enemies' hands, never their lives.
enemies.boss_captain_rusk: A mercenary captain carrying an order sealed by someone the Crown buried years ago.
enemies.boss_red_vial_matron: Head of the Red Vial ledger wing. She believes the heir's blood is the last ingredient.
enemies.boss_marshal_oren: Mahmut's former commander. He signed the order; he did not know the rite would hollow her out.
enemies.boss_ashen_lord_wraith: The Ashen Lord, who once hid the bell-keeper's daughter from the Crown. He kept her face and lost her name.
enemies.boss_eclipse_construct: The hinge of the First Eclipse Altar, built around the Eclipse Bell. It is the instrument, not the author.

items.first_oath_invitation: Granted by the forest shrine keeper to travelers who save a life on the road. It asks one companion to walk with you for good.
items.torn_chronicle_page: A page torn from a village chronicle. Reading what others survived teaches a little.
items.bound_chronicle: A bound chronicle of one road's battles.
items.illuminated_chronicle: An illuminated chronicle from a monastery archive; its margins are full of names.
items.iron_oath_seal: A Crown Guard seal pressed in iron. Old oaths still hold weight when melted down.
items.alchemy_core: A distilled core from the Red Vial archive wing.
items.bellglass_shard: A shard of bell-glass. Hold it to your ear and you hear an hour that is not yours.
items.blacksmith_rivet: A forge rivet in the Flint pattern.
items.forge_dust: Dust swept from a smith's floor. Nothing in a forge is wasted.
items.tactical_notes: Field notes from those who held a line.
items.hymn_leaves: Pressed leaves from the Saint Luthos bell garden, written with verses.
items.memory_shard: A fragment of a companion's memory, bright with one moment.
items.universal_memory_shard: A memory with no name attached. It will fit anyone who remembers.
items.reliquary_medal: A medal struck for those who faced a bell's guardian and came back.
items.t3_charm_blueprint: A jeweler's pattern from before Crownfall.
items.sun_eclipse_token: Minted only on the day the eclipse is said to breathe.
items.unwritten_hour_cinder: A cold cinder from where an hour burned without being counted.
items.weapon_tempering_xp: The worth left in a blade after it is unmade.

codex.text_en: Every life holds counted hours. They can be taken, given, or owed, but never moved without a witness and consent.
House Veyr bound seven bells to count the hours of the living. They do not heal. They keep the ledger.
An hour cannot be written without a name that remembers it. That is why Veyrhold carves names on trees and doors.
Bodies left behind by unpaid hours. Their names are gone; their hours are not.
Six years ago the capital fell, the king died, and the chancellor was recorded dead. The Council of Dukes has ruled since.
Children with no registered family are written into road registers as "Vale". It is a common name, and a lonely one.
The mark of the Royal Inquisition, keepers of sealed records. Its seals still appear on orders no one admits writing.
Alchemists and physicians. One wing keeps antidotes; the other kept a ledger of people.
He taught that a bell is a prayer the whole village hears, and that names spoken aloud are witnesses for the living.
Generations ago the bells were first fixed with an heir's hours. The eclipse over the altar has not moved since.
Seven seals on one uncut cord. They keep the kingdom running, and the throne empty.
A children's story about a court where no one ages. Most people think it is only a story.

oath_01_aveline.tagline_en: The candle is not for the saint. It is for whoever is still inside.

oath_02_sable.tagline_en: No names until we are outside.

oath_03_nara.story_tie_en: The Bridge of the Forsaken, Chapter 5.

oath_04_mirel.tagline_en: This time, my hand writes it back.

oath_05_vespera.tagline_en: Look long enough and it shows you what it cost.

hall_of_ancestors.tagline_en: Every name in this hall once walked a road for someone else.

hall_of_armaments.tagline_en: Every blade here was carried by someone who meant it.

chapter_cards.card_en: Where the trees still remember the names we carve.

chapter_cards.title_en: The Ruined Cathedral of Saint Luthos
chapter_cards.card_en: A bell with no rope. A book with no page.
Every name board blank. Every door still standing.
Not a month now. Weeks, perhaps less.
One white strand. One order signed.
The faces stayed. The names were cut away.

chapter_cards.title_en: The Altar of the First Eclipse
